name: create_infographic
description: Turn structured facts or data into a visual infographic PNG using HTML/CSS layout (charts, sections, icons as CSS/SVG).

content.description: Facts, stats, and labels to visualize. The sub-agent must not invent data.

designBrief.description: Optional visual direction (palette, style, vertical vs horizontal).

height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Default 1600 for vertical infographics.

imagePaths.description: Optional workspace image paths (photos, logos, icons).

imageUrls.description: Optional HTTPS URLs to download before layout.
